reason: The README describes agent skills and Node scripts for integrating games with Paean services, publishing static frontends, downloading and remixing published games, and recording remix lineage; external platform integration is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为游戏项目提供 Paean 平台集成、静态发布、作品 remix 和云存档及排行榜能力的智能体技能集合。
summaries.en: A set of agent skills for integrating games with Paean, publishing static frontends, remixing published games, and adding cloud saves and leaderboards.

capabilities: Reads Paean authentication credentials from environment variables or local credential files
Publishes static frontend projects to Paean-hosted URLs and lists them in Apps Square
Downloads published game sources and creates remix manifests with parent lineage
Writes project files and executes Node.js scripts plus system zip/unzip commands
Integrates browser games with Paean cloud save and shared leaderboard services
